stock.description: Headquartered in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong, IWS Group Holdings Limited operates as a holistic provider of facility services. The company extends its specialized security and facility management solutions to both public sector organizations and private businesses throughout Hong Kong. Its security offerings include manned guarding, bespoke security provisions for events and critical incidents, and essential staffing support deployed at railway stations, various transport hubs, immigration control points (across sea, land, and rail), and other public amenities. Additionally, IWS manages crowd coordination for special events and in emergency scenarios. The facility management division covers comprehensive property administration, the leasing and oversight of car parks, and professional cleaning services. The firm, established in 2018, delivers all its services under the prominent IWS brand.
